title: Key Kiss
tagline: A two-factor secure way to store your wallets private key ...
description:
Welcome to 'key-kiss' (key keep it safe/secure)

A more secure way to store your private key, preventing your funds from being stolen if they find your 12 words.

There are two apps in this project:
The project consists of 2 parts:

+ A CLI, built in Rust, creates an image with a deterministic order depending on your password.

+ A web app (secret kiss paper) that lets you choose the blank slots of your private key in each column.

Both apps create an image, if you put second over the first one you would see the black slots, showing your private key.
how_its_made:
There are two apps in this project:

A cli (secret-image-cli) that creates and image since a deterministic order for characters in matrix with a personal password. built with rust.

A web app (slots-paper-create) that lets you choose the slots of your private key character in each col. built with p5.js
